BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   C. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Money as rumours only.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

5. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   B. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   C. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Banking as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   B. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Business Goals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Banking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
